title: game/data/people/<id>.json: how a person looks (a look, dressed from the wardrobe; the old colour keys beside it are ignored by the game)

figure.description: characters track CH-3b: how this person's figure is shaped (logic/figure-kit.js): a head shape, a build, and how they move beyond the build's own gait (figure-pose.js figurePose)

head.description: a head shape of figureKit.json heads (check-data checks it)

build.description: a build of figureKit.json builds (check-data checks it)

creature.description: a creature person (Kappi, a capybara): drawn from this rig (rigs-next.js, a bodyPlans.json form) instead of the look, standing ht metres tall
